title: Vanishing of ∫Dφ[v]dν on a set of directions extends to its span
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K, φ : ℝ^P → ℝ a C^∞ function with compact support, and S ⊆ ℝ^P a set of vectors such that ∫Dφ(y)[v]dν(y) = 0 for every v ∈ S. Then ∫Dφ(y)[v]dν(y) = 0 for every v in the linear span of S.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → ℝ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ v ∈ S, ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0) → ∀ v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ S, ∫ y, fderiv ℝ φ y v ∂ν = 0
